description: Read the NightWatch trading signal standard as data (GET /signals/standard). Free, no key. A signal is an executable order sheet on a 10,000 USDC reference fund: % of the fund exposed, leverage, order type and price, size, stop-loss and take-profit, and a one-line comment. Two families: single_asset (open, add, reduce, close, set_exit, modify, cancel, no_trade) and portfolio (rebalance with the whole target book, passive or active). Returns versions (nwsp/1, and the nwsp/0 teaching version), profile and message fields, enums, every refusal code with its plain sentence and fix, the follower rules, the cost assumptions and three worked examples you can send to signal_sandbox_check unchanged.
name: signal_standard
title: Read the trading signal standard
